svg.text: Cross-Platform 3P Agent <-> GCP Vertex AI Agent Runtime Interoperability
A2A over HTTP+JSON | IAM Workload Identity Federation (RFC 8693) | Agent Registry & Auth Manager | Dual-Mode Agent Gateway (CLIENT_TO_AGENT + AGENT_TO_ANYWHERE)
• Exchanges JWT at STS -> Calls ReasoningEngine
Outbound Target (Called by GCP over A2A):
• Returns Task with required contextId & Artifacts
Zero static GCP Service Account keys stored in 3P
Direction 1 (Inbound: 3P -> GCP): WIF Authentication & Ingress Governance
IAM Workload Identity Federation (WIF) + Google STS (RFC 8693)
• Exchanges 3P RS256 JWT at https://sts.googleapis.com/v1/token for short-lived Bearer token
• IAM Binding grants roles/aiplatform.user to federated principal://iam.googleapis.com/...
Gotcha #1: Agent Registry does NOT authorize inbound traffic; WIF + IAM governs Direction 1.
Agent Gateway (CLIENT_TO_AGENT Ingress Mode) + Model Armor
• Screens inbound A2A (/v1/card, /v1/message:send) & :streamQuery before hitting agent code
• Model Armor Template (cross-platform-agent-guardrails): PI/Jailbreak + RAI + PII/FERPA DLP
Gotcha #5 & #6: /v1/card requires Bearer auth; CLIENT_TO_AGENT governs query/streamQuery (not asyncQuery).
Gotcha #4: All ReasoningEngines in the same project + region share one Ingress & one Egress Gateway pair.
Direction 2 (Outbound: GCP -> 3P): Agent Registry, Auth Manager & Egress IAP
Agent Registry (Regional: us-central1 — Not Supported in 'us'/'eu' Multi-Region)
• google_agent_registry_service registers 3P A2A_AGENT_CARD (omit top-level interfaces — Gotcha #11)
• Auto-ingests into agents/agentregistry-{uuid} & auto-discovers deployed GCP ReasoningEngine
Gotcha #12: Resolve friendly displayName -> agents/agentregistry-{uuid} via registry.list_agents() at startup.
Agent Identity Auth Manager + Agent Registry Binding
• google_agent_identity_auth_provider stores outbound 3P 2LO/3LO OAuth or Bearer API Token
• google_agent_registry_binding binds Source ReasoningEngine URN -> Target 3P Service URN
• ADK resolves credentials at runtime via CredentialManager.register_auth_provider(GcpAuthProvider())
Agent Gateway (AGENT_TO_ANYWHERE Egress) + IAM UAP + AuthzPolicy
• Default-deny egress proxy via IAP v2 (iap.googleapis.com/resources.egressViaIAP)
• IAM UAP condition scopes egress from attested SPIFFE principalSet://agents.global.org-... to 3P target
Gotcha #2 & #3: Allowlist *.googleapis.com + *.mtls.googleapis.com (avoid HTTP 498) & disable UAP org constraint.
Prevents 404 NOT_FOUND on regional model path
• Resolved once at startup (use .clone() if shared — Gotcha #9)
Prevents "Event loop is closed" across per-turn asyncio.run()
• Validates 3P Task with contextId & converts artifacts
Inbound WIF & Outbound Auth Manager (Keyless Identity)
Agent Registry & A2A Protocol (Discovery & Wire Format)
Dual-Mode Agent Gateway + Model Armor + IAM UAP
Vertex AI Agent Runtime & Gemini 3.8 Flash
